newsitem.title: USA: Christian Coalition to name new director.
newsitem.headline: Christian Coalition to name new director.

text.p: The Christian Coalition will name former Republican Representative Randy Tate of Washington state Wednesday as its new executive director, congressional sources said Tuesday.
The sources said Tate would succeed Ralph Reed, who built the coalition into one of the most powerful factions of the Republican Party, in September.

Tate lost his seat last November after serving in the House for only two years. He is a conservative activist who supported the presidential bid of television evangelist Pat Robertson in 1988. Robertson is founder of the Christian Coalition.
Under Reed, the Coalition membership grew to 1.9 million and it had a $27 million budget last year. It distributed some 45 million voter guides last November through a network of 125,000 churches.
Reed is leaving after eight years to set up a political consultancy that will focus on training grassroots conservative activists for political office.
